verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list support for FP8, INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF, compressed-tensors and more. A dedicated quantization page covers per-scheme backend overrides and registering custom quantization methods, and a community comment credits vLLM's low-precision model support. An early HN comment saying 4-bit wasn't supported dates from launch and is superseded by current docs listing INT4/GPTQ/AWQ, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: per-format loading walkthroughs in the evidence and independent hands-on confirmation of loading each named format.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ

citations.quote: Quantization: FP8, MXFP8/MXFP4, NVFP4, INT8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF, compressed-tensors, ModelOpt, TorchAO, and more
Quantization trades off model precision for smaller memory footprint, allowing large models to be run on a wider range of devices.
vLLM supports registering custom, out-of-tree quantization methods using the `@register_quantization_config` decorator.
